h: APC spokesperson Morka says poverty was not created by the Tinubu administration
p: The ruling party's national publicity secretary, Felix Morka, has argued that poverty in Nigeria existed long before President Tinubu took office. He is reportedly defending the government's economic record ahead of the 2027 campaigns.
more: Opposition parties have blamed the government for rising hardship.
The APC says its reforms are meant to fix long-standing economic problems.
